sentences.en: Friday Chit Chat with Jenna and Angela and Cassie and Sam.
sentences.zh: 与珍娜、安吉拉、卡西和萨姆的周五闲聊。

sentences.en: It's Friday Chit Chat with the office ladies, folks.

sentences.en: We've got a few things to chat about.
We were feeling chatty today, and we thought, why don't we make a whole bonus moment out of it?
sentences.zh: 我们今天感觉挺想聊的，然后就在想，为什么不干脆把它做成一个特别的花絮时刻呢？

sentences.en: I feel like this is going to be, if we keep it going, the sort of kind sister to office ladies, burn it to the ground.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果咱们继续搞下去，这就有点像是《办公室女士》的亲姊妹篇——《付之一炬》。
一个我们什么都能说的地方。

sentences.en: Friday Chit Chat gets a little spicy.
sentences.zh: 周五闲聊会变得有点辛辣。

sentences.en: I'm just saying it's off the cuff.
sentences.zh: 我只是说这是即兴发挥。

sentences.en: It's whatever we're thinking and feeling.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所思所想的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I have no idea what you're about to say to me.
sentences.zh: 对啊，我完全不知道你待会儿要对我说什么。

sentences.en: It's the soothing balm you apply after the burn of...
sentences.zh: 这是你在经历了一番痛击之后涂抹的镇痛舒缓膏……

sentences.en: Office ladies, burn it to the ground?
Well, eventually, we're just going to come on here as cranky old ladies and burn it to the ground.
sentences.zh: 好吧，最终我们都会变成脾气暴躁的老太太，来到这里把它付之一炬。

sentences.en: But right now, we're still feeling a little positive, right?
sentences.zh: 但现在，我们感觉还是有点积极的，对吧？

sentences.en: We're a little peppy with our Friday Chit Chat.
sentences.zh: 我们的周五闲聊还挺有精气神的。

sentences.en: Can I tell you guys how my day started as I came into our building?
sentences.zh: 我能跟你们讲讲我今天进大楼时的一天是怎么开始的吗？

sentences.en: You know how you try to get everything on one trip?
sentences.zh: 你知道那种总想一次性把东西全拿完的心理吧？
所以你手上拿了好几样东西？

sentences.en: Because God forbid you make two trips to the car.
sentences.zh: 因为天呐，你绝对不想去车里拿两趟。

sentences.en: Well, to be fair, where we park is a bit of a trek.
sentences.zh: 好吧，公平地说，我们停车的地方得走挺长一段路的。

sentences.en: It's a bit of a trek.
So I have my laptop, my bag.
sentences.zh: 所以我拿着我的笔记本电脑、包。

sentences.en: I have my little office lady's coffee tumbler mug thing.
sentences.zh: 我还有那个办公室女士的随行咖啡保温杯。

sentences.en: And then I got my phone in the crook of my neck.
sentences.zh: 接着我的脖子夹着电话。
我手上还拿着这些东西。

sentences.en: And I'm trying to hit the elevator button in the building.
sentences.zh: 我正试图按大楼的电梯按钮。
但我整个人都卡得动弹不得。

sentences.en: And the superintendent of our building goes,
sentences.zh: 然后我们大楼的管理员说：

sentences.en: This building has how many floors?
And I'm already running a little late.
sentences.zh: 而且我本来就已经有点迟到了。

sentences.en: He's got every single button lit up.
sentences.zh: 结果他把每一个楼层的按钮全都按亮了。

sentences.en: And Josh is like, where are you?
I'm like, I'm in an elevator, babe.
sentences.zh: 我说，我在电梯里呢，宝贝。

sentences.en: And then he's like, we're testing the elevators today.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我们今天在测试电梯。

sentences.en: So we're stopping at every floor.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要每一层都停。

sentences.en: Did he think this would be what you wanted?

sentences.en: He was like, hey, lady, in a rush, holding lots of stuff.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，女士，看你急急忙忙拿了这么多东西。

sentences.en: I've got a treat for you.
You want to stop at every floor with me?

sentences.en: And so I was like, Josh, I got to go.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，乔什，我得挂了。

sentences.en: And then I said, I need to get off this elevator.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，我得离开这部电梯。

sentences.en: He goes, I go, he said, what floor are you?

sentences.en: And when I told him my floor number, he goes, oh, I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 当我告诉他我的楼层号时，他说，哦，太对不起了。

sentences.en: So then I got off at level two, which I've never been on in this building.
sentences.zh: 所以我后来在二楼下了车，这栋楼里我从来没去过那层。

sentences.en: And is it special or different?
sentences.zh: 那它有什么特别或不同吗？

sentences.zh: 看起来完全一样，但有个家伙的门开着。

sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们所有的门都是关着的。

sentences.zh: 不好意思啊，如果你住独立屋而且拉开着窗帘，我绝对会

sentences.zh: 我不知道以后还会不会见到他，但我会一直惦记着他坐在那把椅子上的样子。

sentences.en: It's going to be hard for me not to stop on the second floor on the way out today.
sentences.zh: 今天出去的时候，我很难忍住不在二楼停下来。

sentences.en: I'm picturing you in a being John Malkovich situation.
sentences.zh: 我脑补了你处在《成为约翰·马尔科维奇》那种情境里。

sentences.en: So that was the energy I brought in this morning.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我今天早上带过来的状态。

sentences.zh: 然后我就想说，珍娜，你和我……她说，留到周五闲聊时再说吧。
